name: Krishak Sramik Party
role: Peasant-Labour Political Party in East Bengal
contribution: Krishak Sramik Party carried A. K. Fazlul Huq's peasant-labour political legacy into the United Front campaign and the 1954 provincial election.
context: East Bengal agrarian politics, United Front coalition-building, and the post-language-movement challenge to Muslim League rule.
impact: It helped connect the United Front's autonomy programme with rural, peasant, and labour-oriented claims rooted in Bengal politics.
highlight: A. K. Fazlul Huq's peasant-labour party in the 1954 United Front coalition.
seoTitle: Krishak Sramik Party - A. K. Fazlul Huq and United Front Profile
seoDescription: Profile of Krishak Sramik Party, A. K. Fazlul Huq, and the 1954 United Front election in East Bengal.
shortAnswer: Krishak Sramik Party was A. K. Fazlul Huq's peasant-labour party and a key United Front component in 1954.

faq.question: Why does Krishak Sramik Party matter in 1954?
faq.answer: It linked A. K. Fazlul Huq's rural political base to the United Front's provincial autonomy and anti-Muslim League campaign.
